name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin
description: Bindex Maven Plugin is a Java 8 Maven plugin that generates Bindex metadata for a Maven project. Its bindex aggregator goal runs an interactive, document-scanning Ghostwriter workflow without requiring a Maven project, while its bindex-per-module goal runs the same workflow for each Maven module. The plugin resolves compile and runtime dependencies, can process documentation in parallel or non-recursively, and configures its GenAI workflow from Maven and project settings. When a Maven server identifier is configured, credentials and custom XML values from the matching settings.xml server entry are supplied to the processor. It is intended for Maven builds that need structured artifact metadata to support semantic discovery and GenAI-assisted integration.

constructors.description: Creates the aggregator Maven mojo that implements the bindex goal. Maven instantiates and configures this mojo when the goal is invoked.

examples.description: Step 1: install the plugin by adding this declaration to the build plugins in pom.xml. Step 2: configure any required Ghostwriter or server settings in the Maven project or settings.xml. Step 3: invoke the Maven-managed org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo with mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.3.2:bindex.

constructors.description: Creates the per-module Maven mojo for the bindex-per-module goal. Maven uses this mojo in a project module.

examples.description: After installing and configuring the plugin in a module pom.xml, run this command from that module. Maven constructs org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo and scans that module's configured documents.

features.name: bindex
features.description: Runs the thread-safe aggregator bindex goal. It initializes usage statistics, creates and configures an ActProcessor, and executes the interactive document-scanning workflow. The goal does not require a Maven project and resolves compile plus runtime dependencies.

examples.description: Use this scenario to generate Bindex metadata from the root of a Maven build. First add the plugin dependency to pom.xml, then configure Ghostwriter properties such as gw.acts and gw.model as appropriate, and finally run this command to invoke the aggregator goal.

features.name: bindex-per-module
features.description: Runs the thread-safe non-aggregator goal for a Maven project module. It initializes and configures the workflow processor, then scans documents for the current module with compile plus runtime dependency resolution.

examples.description: Use this in a multi-module build when each module needs separate Bindex processing. Configure the plugin in the module build and run the command from the module directory or bind the goal to a suitable lifecycle phase.

features.name: configureAndScan
features.description: Configures an ActProcessor and runs the document scan. Configuration can include credentials and custom values resolved from a configured Maven settings.xml server entry.

examples.description: For a workflow requiring server credentials, add a matching server entry to settings.xml, configure the plugin to use that server identifier, then run the bindex Maven goal. org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo transfers the server values to its processor configuration before scanning.

examples.title: Aggregator goal: generate Bindex metadata for an entire Maven build
steps: Install: declare the plugin in the build's pluginManagement or plugins section: <plugin><groupId>org.machanism.machai</groupId><artifactId>bindex-maven-plugin</artifactId><version>1.3.2</version></plugin>. No project is required to invoke the goal directly, since org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo declares requiresProject = false.

Configure: set the scan root with -Dgw.path (defaults to the current project directory if omitted), select a GenAI provider/model with -Dgw.model (for example openai:gpt-4o-mini), and optionally supply -Dgw.instructions to point at additional instruction locations. When the configured workflow needs GenAI credentials, add a <server> entry to ~/.m2/settings.xml with an id, username, and password, and reference it with -Dgenai.serverId=<server-id>; org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo.getConfiguration() reads that entry's username, password, and any custom XML configuration values into the processor configuration.
Review the generated Bindex metadata under the scanned path and use it for semantic artifact discovery or GenAI-assisted integration.

examples.title: Per-module goal: run Bindex processing during a standard reactor build
steps: Install: add the same plugin declaration to each module's pom.xml, or bind the goal to a lifecycle phase in a parent pom.xml's pluginManagement.

Configure: pass -Dgw.model and -Dgw.path as needed; org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo (requiresProject = true, aggregator = false) only performs work from the execution-root project unless the gw.nonRecursive user property is overridden, avoiding duplicate scans across reactor modules.

Run: mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.3.2:bindex-per-module -Dgw.path=src/site from the reactor root, or bind the bindex-per-module goal to a build phase so it runs automatically during mvn install.
Review the resulting Bindex metadata generated for the execution-root module context.
